note: No dedicated icon-size scale exists in tailwind.config.js. Icon sizing is expressed as inline Tailwind width/height utility pairs at the call site (e.g. FAQ chevrons at PageParts.jsx:126 use h-2 w-2 for dot indicators; nav icons in MenuIcons.jsx are sized per-icon). Recorded here as an evidence gap rather than inventing a scale that doesn't exist in the source.
